steps.code: (() => { const k=document.querySelector('.katex-html'); if(!k) return 'no-katex-html'; const all=k.querySelectorAll('*'); const withStyle=[...all].filter(e=>e.hasAttribute('style')); return JSON.stringify({nodes:all.length, withStyleAttr:withStyle.length, sampleStyle:withStyle.slice(0,3).map(e=>e.getAttribute('style')), vlistOuterHTML:k.querySelector('.vlist')?k.querySelector('.vlist').outerHTML.slice(0,240):null}); })()
